versions.content: When an I-PDU is transmitted because of the function Com_TriggerIPDUSend or Com_TriggerIPDUSendWithMetaData, the AUTOSAR COM module shall only take the minimum delay time into account. That is the AU- TOSAR COM module shall postpone transmissions if necessary and reset the mini- mum delay timer in case of transmissions. The AUTOSAR COM module shall not take into account all other transmission mode related parameters like ComTxMode- NumberOfRepetitions.
